finalText:
All 12 files migrated cleanly. `session.js` also has a `cache.query` call at line 18, but that's the cache module, not `db` — unrelated.

The only remaining `db.query` is in `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js`, which is a vendored file marked "do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade," so I left it alone. `db.query` in `lib/db.js` stays too, since that vendor file still depends on it.

Migration's done: 12 files, 36 call sites (`get`, `list`, `update` in each), all now using `db.execute({ sql, params })`.
